name: ORIGINS_UGC_FIRSTTRY_H1
look: ordinary phone footage in a lived-in Malaysian condo bedroom, late afternoon window light, clear and watchable

character.who: Malaysian Malay woman, mid 20s, wearing a loose cotton tudung in dusty pink
character.face: soft round face, no heavy makeup, small mole near the left eyebrow

ugc.creator: a beginner who has always bought ready-made perfume; curious, a little dry-humoured, comfortable on camera but not polished; recently bought her first perfume oils
ugc.motivation: her friend dared her to make her own scent instead of buying another bottle, so she is recording her very first try to send back
ugc.setting: bedroom vanity table with a few skincare bottles, a mug and a phone charger; daylight from a window on her left; tidy but lived-in
ugc.camera: rear phone camera propped against the mirror at chest height, framing her from mid-chest up with the table edge in shot, slightly off-centre, stays still apart from one small bump when she touches the table
ugc.opening: first frame: she is already holding a small amber dropper bottle up between two fingers, eyebrows raised at the lens; first line straight away, no greeting
ugc.product_handling: right hand unscrews the dropper of a plain unbranded amber 10ml bottle, left hand stays flat on the table; she lets one drop fall onto her left inner wrist, puts the bottle down, rubs wrists together lightly once and lifts her wrist to smell from a short distance
imperfections: glances at the screen once to check framing
a short pause before the second line
ugc.performance: matter-of-fact, half-amused, eye contact only on the first and last line, looks at her wrist while smelling; small surprised nod, no big reaction
ugc.cta: the video ends on her look of mild surprise; CTA is added in the edit end card
ugc.continuity: same tudung colour and drape, same t-shirt, the same single amber bottle, the same table layout, mole on the left side
hooks: My friend said I can't make perfume. Watch me.
I spent RM9.90 instead of RM300. Let's see.
Okay, first time doing this, don't judge.

shots.action: she holds the dropper bottle up and delivers the hook
shots.speaker: She
shots.line: My friend said I can't make perfume.

shots.action: she lets one drop fall on her inner wrist, rubs wrists once and smells, then nods, mildly impressed
shots.speaker: She
